releases.body:
Retitle reliability fixes:
- retitle after completed turns using the delivered transcript
- include compaction summaries in title context
- protect manual renames across save windows, pruning, and plugin instances
- skip child/subagent sessions and blank renames
- fork retitles wait for a completed response
- built-in title attribution refreshed on the title response; grace reduced to 2 minutes
- OpenCode 2.2.3 / @opencode/plugin 2.2.3 compatibility

77 tests passing.

### Fixes

- Fresh sessions no longer get their auto-generated title mistaken for a manual
  rename on multi-location setups. The plugin scopes itself to its own directory
  and keeps the "built-in title in flight" marker in shared storage, so
  `/retitle-status` stops reporting "manual / external" and retitling stays active.
- The title prompt is now hard-capped: 1000 characters per message line and 3100
  overall, so a large paste cannot inflate the request.

### Configuration

- New `builtinGraceMs` option (default 45000) controls how long a built-in title
  generation stays attributable to OpenCode.
